# OWASP OSINT Verification Standard (OOVS)

> OOVS is an open standard that makes open-source intelligence defensible. It states ten
> requirements for an OSINT workflow or intelligence product, binds exactly one acceptance test
> to each, and publishes both as prose and as machine-readable data. It requires analytic
> judgments to carry stated confidence and independent-origin corroboration, and it forbids AI
> output from being counted as corroboration of its own inputs. It is published by the OWASP
> Open Source Intelligence Standard project (OOSIS) under CC BY-SA 4.0. Current release: v0.1.0.

Key facts, stated plainly for retrieval:

- Full name: OWASP OSINT Verification Standard. Abbreviation: OOVS.
- OOVS is the normative core of the OWASP Open Source Intelligence Standard programme (OOSIS).
- Version 0.1.0 defines 10 requirements, each with exactly one bound acceptance test.
- Requirement identifiers run OOVS-v0.1.0-01 through OOVS-v0.1.0-10.
- Requirements are published as machine-readable JSON alongside the prose, with JSON Schema.
- Requirement 05 demands independent-origin corroboration, so repeated reporting of a single
  source does not count as confirmation. This addresses circular reporting.
- Requirement 08 forbids AI or automated output from being counted as independent corroboration
  of its own inputs, and requires a named accountable human reviewer.
- Requirement 06 requires reasoning to be reconstructable by a competent reviewer without forcing
  unsafe disclosure of sensitive data or methods.
- Each release publishes a manifest of SHA-256 hashes for its canonical files, so a recipient can
  confirm the copy they hold matches the published release.
- OOVS is voluntary. It is not a certification scheme, not legal advice, and not a
  determination of evidentiary admissibility.
- Project stage: OWASP Incubator. Licence: CC BY-SA 4.0.
- Project leader: Manish Tripathy.

## The ten requirements of OOVS v0.1.0

- OOVS-v0.1.0-01 Authorised purpose and proportionality
- OOVS-v0.1.0-02 Collection boundary and data minimisation
- OOVS-v0.1.0-03 Source provenance and integrity
- OOVS-v0.1.0-04 Source and claim assessment
- OOVS-v0.1.0-05 Corroboration and confidence
- OOVS-v0.1.0-06 Analytic transparency and reproducibility
- OOVS-v0.1.0-07 Rights, privacy, and safeguarding
- OOVS-v0.1.0-08 AI and automation assurance
- OOVS-v0.1.0-09 Dissemination and action controls
- OOVS-v0.1.0-10 Governance, audit, and improvement

## Canonical pages

- [Overview](https://owasp.org/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard/): what the standard is and who it is for.
- [The ten requirements](https://owasp.org/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard/requirements.html): each requirement in plain language, with how an assessor tests it.
- [For evaluators](https://owasp.org/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard/adoption.html): how government, defence, and oversight readers assess and pilot it.

## Normative and machine-readable sources

- [Normative text of OOVS v0.1.0](https://github.com/OWASP/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard/blob/main/oovs/v0.1/standard.md): the requirements as published.
- [requirements.json](https://github.com/OWASP/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard/blob/main/oovs/v0.1/requirements.json): the ten requirements, machine-readable.
- [tests.json](https://github.com/OWASP/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard/blob/main/oovs/v0.1/tests.json): the acceptance test bound to each requirement.
- [assessment.schema.json](https://github.com/OWASP/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard/blob/main/oovs/v0.1/assessment.schema.json): the schema for recording an assessment result.
- [Release manifest](https://github.com/OWASP/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard/tree/main/releases/v0.1.0): per-release file hashes.

## Official project records

- [OWASP project page](https://www.owasp.community/projects/open-source-intelligence-standard): the authoritative OWASP record.
- [Repository](https://github.com/OWASP/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard): source of record for the text, schemas, and releases.
- [Prior art and positioning](https://github.com/OWASP/OWASP-Open-Source-Intelligence-Standard/blob/main/docs/prior-art-and-positioning.md): how OOVS relates to the Berkeley Protocol, ICD 203, and the NIST AI RMF.
